proposer: A language model (Claude, Anthropic) run as a sub-agent of the session that prepared v0.3.1, with no memory of the runs recorded against v0.3.0. It was given the output of tools/propose.py and nothing else, and was told not to read the repository. That instruction was not enforced.

proposals.why: The outage margin is the one closest to its limit, so it sets the radius. I expect shedding a little more load in an outage to lower that margin and widen the radius, without hurting the objective.
Shedding more load cost 1 ppm of objective, so shed alone is refused. Now I test capture on its own. I expect capturing more heat in liquid to raise the objective and lower the sorption margin.

Capture moved two margins a long way but left the objective flat, so the step was too far. Now I test the load floor alone. I expect a lower floor to raise the load floor margin a little and to change the objective, and I want to see which way.
